# Notes

<!--
Anything a reviewer needs that the diff does not say on its own. Drop headings
that do not apply, but do not skip them because they are inconvenient — an
unstated gap is the thing that bites later.
-->

**Decisions worth reviewing**

<!--
Choices a reasonable reviewer might have made differently, each with its reason.
Point at docs/decisions.md rather than restating an entry that already exists.
-->

**Verification**

<!--
What was actually run, and what it showed. Tests, typecheck, lint, build, and any
manual or browser checks. Say what was verified, not just that verification
happened.
-->

**Known issues and gaps**

<!--
Anything incomplete, unverified, or deferred, and anything a reviewer should not
be surprised by. State explicitly what was NOT checked — "unit tested but not
verified end to end" is far more useful than silence.
-->
